title: Palace Theater, One-Eyed Babe and Alfred Williams
summary: Robinson never worked in theaters, played often with Babe Phillips for uptown jobs, and Alfred Williams left for El Paso.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Did you ever work at the Palace Theater? Uh uh.
